datasetSource: Official SpaceNet 7 Multi-Temporal Urban Development Dataset (s3://spacenet-dataset/spacenet/SN7_buildings/train/)
positiveCriterion: Ground-truth SpaceNet 7 annotations show >= 12 newly constructed building footprints AND >= 1,500 m² new building footprint area within the 512x512 sub-tile.
negativeCriterion: Ground-truth SpaceNet 7 annotations show <= 2 newly constructed or removed building footprints AND <= 350 m² new building area within the 512x512 sub-tile.
leakagePrevention: Strict 3-way AOI-level geographic cluster split (Train / Validation / Held-Out Test) plus 150 km Haversine metropolitan group clustering: zero shared AOIs across splits, >330 km minimum separation between all splits (>424 km to Held-Out Test), z-score standardization & weights fit strictly on Train (n=47), hyperparameters, pixel change threshold (32), model family, and Platt probability calibration fit strictly on out-of-sample Non-Test logits (5-Fold Geo-CV on Train + Validation, n=59), and final metrics evaluated once on untouched Held-Out Test (n=12).

structuralChangePct.label: Filtered Structural Change Area
structuralChangePct.description: Percentage of cloud-free pixels retained in candidate change clusters after sub-pixel co-registration, PIF radiometric normalization, PIF-normalized vegetation/snow/bare-soil suppression, smooth-shadow filtering, and 5-of-9 geodesic opening.

highAlbedoGainPct.label: Non-Vegetated Bright Surface Gain
highAlbedoGainPct.description: Percentage of valid pixels transitioning toward brighter, edge-bearing, low-greenness reflectance characteristic of new roofs, concrete pads, or graded construction earthworks.

meanClusterEdgeGain.label: Stabilized Cluster Sobel Edge Gain
meanClusterEdgeGain.description: Empirical-Bayes area-shrunk increase in orientation-decorrelated 3x3 Sobel gradient magnitude across candidate clusters, preventing isolated gravel pads from producing extreme edge ratios.

compactClusterDensityKm2.label: Rectangular Compact Cluster Density
compactClusterDensityKm2.description: Spatial density of discrete, compact, bounded-aspect-ratio (<= 3.2:1) candidate building clusters (10–950 px area with sharp wall edge gain) per square kilometer.

seasonalVegShiftFraction.label: Seasonal & Environmental Shift Ratio
seasonalVegShiftFraction.description: Fraction of raw spectral pixel differences attributable to PIF-normalized Excess-Green phenology changes, plowed agricultural soil, autumn leaf-off, or scene-wide seasonal snow washes.

newEdgeEmergencePct.label: New Structural Edge Emergence
newEdgeEmergencePct.description: Percentage of valid non-vegetated pixels where strong boundaries emerged on previously smooth ground or sunlit desert sand, or rotated relative to prior edges.

roofShadowDipolePct.label: 3D Roof-Shadow Contrast Dipole
roofShadowDipolePct.description: Percentage of valid non-vegetated pixels gaining sharp 5x5 local luminance range from adjacent sunlit roof and cast shadow pairs (captures both dark-soil and bright-sand buildings).

patchActivityConcentration.label: Urban Block Patch Concentration
patchActivityConcentration.description: Percentage of 64x64 pixel urban-block sub-patches exhibiting co-occurring candidate clusters, newly emerged structural edges, and 3D roof-shadow dipoles.

baselineComparison.baselineModelLabel: Existing Baseline v3.0 (Uncalibrated L2 Logistic, thresh=28, λ=2.5)

candidateModels.modelLabel: Existing Baseline v3.0 (Uncalibrated L2 Logistic, thresh=28, λ=2.5)
candidateModels.description: Previous deployed v3.0 classifier: raw uncalibrated L2 logistic probabilities (λ=2.5, τ=0.52), unnormalized ExG2/VARI2, pixel changeThreshold=28.

candidateModels.modelLabel: Improved v4.0 (Platt-Calibrated Geo-Weighted L2 Logistic, Red-Gated ExG & Glare Filter)
candidateModels.description: Red-absorption-gated Excess-Green (prevents desert sand & limestone false vegetation), 3D tropical dipole exemption, co-linear roof glare suppression, changeThreshold=32, and non-test Platt calibration.

candidateModels.modelLabel: Candidate v4.0 (Calibrated Balanced Random Forest Ensemble)
candidateModels.description: Class-balanced bootstrap Random Forest with sqrt(d) feature subsampling, Laplace-smoothed depth-2/3 trees, and out-of-fold probability calibration on the improved v4.0 features.

candidateModels.modelLabel: Candidate v4.0 (Calibrated Class-Weighted GBDT Depth-2 Ensemble)
candidateModels.description: Second-order Newton gradient boosted depth-2 decision trees with L2 leaf regularization, geographic cluster sample weights, and out-of-fold calibration on the improved v4.0 features.

baselineComparison.selectionRationale: Selected Improved v4.0 Calibrated Geo-Weighted L2 Logistic Regression strictly via non-test evaluation (5-Fold Geo-CV F1 90.2%, Geo-CV AUC 0.938, Val F1 100.0%, Val AUC 1.000, Val Brier 0.0498, Val LogLoss 0.1915) over Existing Baseline v3.0 (Geo-CV AUC 0.922, Val Brier 0.1089), Balanced Random Forest (Geo-CV F1 84.0%), and GBDT (Geo-CV F1 84.6%). Held-Out Test split (n=12) remained completely untouched.

modelLabel: Calibrated Geo- & Class-Weighted L2 Logistic Regression (v4.0)

calibration.fittedOn: Out-of-fold 5-Fold Geographic Group CV (Train n=47) + Validation (n=12) — Held-Out Test strictly excluded

benchmarkOnNonTest.label: Uncalibrated Raw Sigmoid
benchmarkOnNonTest.notes: Direct logistic sigmoid P = 1 / (1 + exp(-z)); L2 weight shrinkage compresses clear logits toward 0.50.

benchmarkOnNonTest.label: Platt Sigmoid Scaling (a=1.13, b=-0.00)
benchmarkOnNonTest.notes: 2-parameter smooth monotone calibration fit on n=59 non-test OOF+Val logits; reverses L2 probability compression without step overfitting.

benchmarkOnNonTest.label: Isotonic PAV Regression (5 monotone steps)
benchmarkOnNonTest.notes: Non-parametric step-wise calibration; higher variance on n=59 samples produces coarser probability plateaus and higher out-of-fold log loss.
